knowledge_units.trigger: User wanted the latest changes without scrolling; prior chart emphasized prior-close levels.
knowledge_units.principle: A useful market state report distinguishes level, change and change horizon.
knowledge_units.pattern: Fixed three-column comparison: previous accepted observation, aligned 15-minute baseline, previous regular-session close; show baseline timestamps and elapsed interval.
knowledge_units.method: Resolve identity/unit/session/basis, choose prior available baseline without lookahead, reject excessive misalignment, calculate return or bp, render latest-first.
knowledge_units.application: QQQ/SMH pressure versus yields/credit; prior checks and after-hours moves.
knowledge_units.architecture: B02 observations -> B17 market_context -> compact renderer; B06 supplies bounded range context.

families.mechanism: Explicit baseline and timestamp invariants prevent unlike or future comparisons.
Put the actionable change and its coverage first, with details expandable.

knowledge_units.counterexample: A later snapshot containing the same observed_at is no_new_observation, not evidence of fresh stability. Weekly inventory has no genuine 15-minute delta.
knowledge_units.decision: Reuse PR101; avoid a competing engine or arbitrary unified bp/percent ranking.

knowledge_units.trigger: Mobile gray-track/blue-bar rendering looked like a nested range, although authored values were returns from zero.
knowledge_units.principle: Visual encodings must have explicit semantics tied to observed data.
knowledge_units.pattern: Bullet/small-multiple design: observed historical outer band, session band, independently defined pocket, current/previous markers and direction.
knowledge_units.method: Specify window start/end/session and price basis for every band; label endpoints; reject implicit all-supplied-history extrema.
knowledge_units.application: A rebound inside a falling pocket differs from a migration to a higher pocket.
knowledge_units.architecture: B06 range engine owns geometry; B17 consumes its typed results; renderer cannot invent support.

families.mechanism: Band meaning is an input contract, not an inferred visual convention.
Nested bands preserve multiple horizons in a narrow mobile row; analogy only, no external prior-art citation verified here.

knowledge_units.counterexample: The old gray plotting track is not a historical high-low or support level.
knowledge_units.decision: Keep desired nested visualization as an extension; discard interpreting old chart as observed ranges.
knowledge_units.evidence: User screenshot and explicit assistant correction; receiver bounded-range tests reported

knowledge_units.trigger: Oil prices declined while physical diesel availability remained stressed.
knowledge_units.principle: Raw inputs, processing capacity, specification-compliant output and delivered availability are distinct economic states.
knowledge_units.pattern: Physical constraint chain: crude access -> refinery throughput/yield -> ULSD specification -> export cargo -> transport/insurance -> regional stock/terminal delivery.
knowledge_units.method: Track stock vs flow, exact product/specification/geography, operating/restoration state, effective/release times and crack-spread basis; test relief against actual delivered output.
knowledge_units.application: US low-sulfur distillate/PADD data, Middle East transit/refinery disruption, Russian export losses, Europe/Asia replacement supply.
knowledge_units.architecture: B03 events + B02 time series -> B17 physical-risk context; no canonical event/data writes from this worker.

families.mechanism: A restored upstream link does not bypass a downstream bottleneck.
Price relief hypothesis requires refinery/shipping/inventory confirmation; keep lagged data periods visible.

knowledge_units.counterexample: National distillate stocks include heating/other uses and may be unavailable locally; days-of-supply is not a countdown to exhaustion. Zero tracked transits may reflect AIS coverage.
knowledge_units.decision: Both trading and physical scope, with trading first; no claim that cheaper crude solves diesel scarcity.
knowledge_units.evidence: proposal source breadcrumbs; historical market claims require fresh source vintages before current reuse

knowledge_units.trigger: Snapshots were initially retrieved without durable capture; later hashes alone did not let another session access bytes.
knowledge_units.principle: Evidence identity, payload retention and canonical acceptance are three separate gates.
knowledge_units.pattern: Capture raw response/request/timestamps once; hash immutable bytes; preserve recoverable artifacts; owner adapter imports with idempotency and correction handling.
knowledge_units.method: Validate JSONL, counts and hashes; package originals without canonical reinterpretation; receiver validates inner hashes; preserve partial recoveries and source availability bounds.
knowledge_units.application: 58 observation records including eight partial recoveries, four complete saved raw snapshots; original matching bytes recovered in source workspace during this review.
knowledge_units.architecture: Private recovery artifact -> B02 approved resolver/store; GitHub holds manifest/contracts, not continuous quote payloads.

families.mechanism: Append-only revisions and frozen source identity permit replay without mutating prior knowledge.
Keep raw-source acquisition, canonical normalization and report consumption independently testable.

knowledge_units.counterexample: Re-querying a current snapshot cannot recreate an earlier snapshot; later historical bars may have provider corrections.
knowledge_units.decision: Preserve originals and route import, rather than build another store or pretend hashes reconstruct data.

knowledge_units.trigger: Early user thesis challenged EPS sustainability despite lower competitive prices and acknowledged declining unit costs/TAM growth.
knowledge_units.principle: Business growth and shareholder return require separate bridges.
knowledge_units.pattern: Price = EPS times exit multiple; gross profit = volume times (selling price minus unit cost); EPS also depends on operating costs, tax and diluted shares.
knowledge_units.method: Model price/cost/volume jointly, reconcile gross to net earnings and cash flow, use matched calendar periods, evaluate share-count effects net of dilution and avoid double-counting FCF allocated to buybacks/dividends/JVs.
knowledge_units.application: NVDA premium CUDA moat with edge/robotics/AI-RAN expansion; FTNT price decline can leave a demanding earnings path.
knowledge_units.architecture: Company evidence and B04 valuation receive a hypothesis record; macro component supplies rate/risk context, not fair-value probabilities.

families.mechanism: Decompose return drivers and falsify volume/margin assumptions independently.

knowledge_units.counterexample: Expanding TAM alone does not establish captured revenue, profitable timing or a doubling probability. Gross margin is not net margin, FCF is not additional earnings.
knowledge_units.decision: Retain as research hypotheses; do not claim missing prior valuation calculations completed.
knowledge_units.destination: Existing company/B04 research if resumed, not macro engine
knowledge_units.evidence: Visible user questions; absent complete verified worksheets limit conclusions

knowledge_units.trigger: Posted handoff and draft PR were initially conflated with closure, while issue/PR descriptions lagged actual files and user decisions.
knowledge_units.principle: Proposal persistence, acceptance, tested implementation, integration and operation need independent states.
knowledge_units.pattern: Linked canonical intake records disposition per deliverable; sender verifies its own artifacts; receiver owns acceptance evidence.
knowledge_units.method: Inspect relevant head/files/receipt; correct current summaries without deleting historical claims; close local scope only after no local executable obligation remains.
knowledge_units.application: #136 receiver accepted #158 and independently reported tests plus D2 failure; no domain acceptance inferred from shared CI.
knowledge_units.architecture: GitHub issue/PR truth with existing worker contracts; no second queue or mandatory new closeout framework.

families.mechanism: Separate lifecycle states and preserve how claims changed.

knowledge_units.counterexample: A shared green workflow or accepted handoff does not pass D1-D8; 0/8 fully accepted remains visible.
knowledge_units.decision: User-pasted transfer endpoint accepted, now actual receiver acceptance also verified; no merge/release.

execution_audit.scale: Ten dimensions 0-5; judgment aid, not completion percentage, trading accuracy or measured productivity.
execution_audit.limits: No token/time telemetry or full early assistant history; score only observable behavior. External implementation gaps are not penalties.

failures.actual: Fetched snapshots before consistently saving raw responses; user had to request JSONL persistence.
failures.better_path: Make capture persistence part of each provider request, with a single verified capture envelope before analysis.
failures.root: Analysis and evidence acquisition were separate ad hoc steps.
failures.prevention: Capture-first adapter with idempotent append and manifest; fail visible if persistence fails.
failures.test: Repeated response saves one economic record; capture available after process restart; partial recovery cannot be tagged raw.

failures.actual: Misread the user's 'range within range' observation as solely analytical; screenshot showed mobile renderer behavior.
failures.better_path: Inspect supplied rendering and explain actual track/segment semantics before proposing nested ranges.
failures.root: Assumed authored chart specification implied the user's rendered representation.
failures.prevention: Validate rendered semantics against input contract; explicitly label scales and observed intervals.
failures.test: A reader can distinguish zero-return bar from observed high-low/pocket; all bands expose horizons.

failures.actual: Repeated closure reports while issue body/PR summary still said acknowledgment pending and one file; initial evidence retention gap remained.
failures.better_path: Fresh narrow receipt/file check, consistent current metadata, preserve payload bytes when accessible.
failures.root: Narrative status updated faster than durable task metadata and recovery resources.
failures.prevention: One final artifact/receipt/obligation reconciliation before archive; no whole-project audit.
failures.test: Issue, PR, manifest and closeout agree on files, receiver status, unrun tests and external ownership.
